name: structInsert
description: Inserts a key-value pair into a structure.
syntax: structInsert( struct struct, string key, any value, [boolean allowOverwrite] )

params.name: struct
params.description: Structure to contain the new key-value pair.

params.name: key
params.description: Key that contains the inserted value.

params.name: allowOverwrite
params.description: Whether to allow overwriting a key. Default: False.
